julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant Cyan (#00E5FF) to complement the crisp architectural lines of the transit hub, evoking a sense of clean energy and the quiet technological hum of the city's infrastructure.
storyPanel: The morning commute through the Sector 7 bio-transit hub is always a rush, but there's a certain calm in the architecture. High above the mag-lev platforms, the maintenance crew takes a quick break among the hydroponic ferns, watching the automated transit pods weave through the steel scaffolding. It's hard work keeping the city moving, but sharing a quiet moment of camaraderie before the next shift starts makes the sprawl feel a little more like home.
